full_prompt_en: A square vintage-style painted illustration shows a dark-haired woman seated on a low white wall against a vivid turquoise-blue backdrop. She wears a cream blouse with its collar open and sleeves pushed to the forearms, a fitted red skirt, sheer dark stockings, and pointed red shoes. One leg bends high on the wall while the other extends diagonally down toward the lower right. Her left hand braces on the ledge beside a worn brown suitcase, and her face turns up toward the upper left with a composed, distant expression. Short black hair frames her face in loose waves; red lips and pale skin stand out against the saturated blue wall. The brown rectangular suitcase occupies the far left, its handle and scuffed surface clearly visible. The white ledge cuts horizontally across the lower quarter and carries gray stains, cracks, and warm ocher wear. Behind, the turquoise field is heavily distressed by irregular scraped beige patches, especially at the top and right edge. The woman and case cast dark painterly shadows down the wall and across the ledge. Light seems to come from the upper left, brightening her blouse, face, and bare knee while deepening the folds of the red skirt. Brush marks are broad and rough in the wall, smoother and more controlled in the face and limbs. The red figure forms a dynamic diagonal within simple blocks of blue and white, giving the scene a bold editorial composition with a sense of waiting or departure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古绘画插画呈现一位黑发女子坐在低白墙上，背后是鲜明青蓝底面。她穿领口敞开的奶油色衬衫，袖子推至前臂，搭配贴身红裙、半透明深丝袜和尖头红鞋。一条腿高高弯在墙上，另一条朝右下斜伸。左手撑在磨旧棕手提箱旁的墙沿，脸仰向左上，神情平静而望远。短黑发以松波纹围住脸，红唇和浅肤在饱和蓝墙前突出。棕色长方箱占最左侧，提手和擦旧表面清楚。白矮墙水平切过下四分之一，带灰污、裂纹和暖赭磨损。后方青蓝色域被不规则刮掉的米色斑块严重磨旧，顶部和右缘尤多。女子与箱子在墙面及墙沿投下深色绘画感阴影。光似来自左上，提亮衬衫、脸和弯起的膝，同时加深红裙褶暗。墙面笔痕宽而粗，面孔与四肢更平顺、更受控。红色人影在简单蓝白色块里形成活跃斜线，令场景有大胆编辑插画构图和等待或出发之感。
style_prompt_en: A vintage editorial painting sets a vivid turquoise-blue field above a broad chipped white horizontal band. A strong warm-red diagonal focal mass cuts across the simple geometry, with dark shadow shapes lending weight beneath it. Cream and pale skinlike highlights brighten the center, while a compact worn brown block anchors one side. The background is deliberately distressed with ocher scrapes, irregular missing patches, and dry-brush flecks; the focal contours are smoother and more carefully modeled. Upper-side light creates clear lit planes and dark cast shapes without losing the rough painterly surface. Large color areas carry the composition, with only a few crisp details at the focal edges. Saturated blue-red contrast, a low horizontal base, and a slanting figurelike rhythm produce a bold, slightly nostalgic mood.
style_prompt_zh: 复古编辑插画把鲜明青蓝色域放在宽阔剥落白色水平带上方。一处强暖红斜向焦点色团切过简单几何，深影形在其下增加重量。奶油色与浅肤般亮面提亮中央，一侧紧凑磨旧棕块固定构图。背景有意保留赭色刮痕、不规则掉色片和干刷碎点；焦点轮廓则更平顺、塑形更谨慎。上方侧光造出清楚亮面和深色投影，同时保留粗绘画表面。大片色域承担构图，只有焦点边缘少量清晰细节。饱和蓝红对照、低水平基底和斜向人物般节奏形成大胆、略带怀旧的情绪。
theme_en: A woman in red seated on a white ledge beside a suitcase
theme_zh: 红裙女子坐在白色矮墙上，身旁放着手提箱
name: Robert McGinnis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
